notes.text: The Helix mark: three isometric plates descending from violet to the ground colour, with the wordmark alongside. Inlined rather than loaded as an `` so the bottom plate and the wordmark can take `currentColor`. In the source SVG both are the near-black `#0B1220`, which would disappear against the dark theme's background — the plate has to follow the foreground rather than stay fixed. The two violets are brand constants and do not vary by theme.
